_notice: DEMO CONTENT. VAELO Atelier is a fictional clothing brand created for a portfolio project. Names, prices, figures and stories are invented. Photos are real Unsplash photos (Unsplash License) hot-linked from images.unsplash.com; they show garments that are not made by any brand called VAELO. Keep frontend/src/content/demo-content.json in sync with `npm run sync:demo`.

company.name: VAELO Atelier
company.tagline: Slow-made clothing from one small atelier
company.headline: Clothes made slowly, to be worn for years.
company.introduction: VAELO cuts and sews coats, knitwear, shirts and denim in one studio, in runs of a few hundred. We buy cloth from six mills we have visited, finish the seams that take strain by hand, and repair anything we have made, for free, for as long as you own it.
company.story: VAELO started in 2014 in a rented corner of a shirt factory: two pattern cutters, one overlocker and a rail of coats nobody had ordered. The coats sold, slowly, to people who came back years later asking for a repair instead of a replacement. That request shaped everything since. We design each piece to be mended, keep every pattern on file, and still cut the first run of every style ourselves.
company.mission: Make fewer clothes, better, and keep them in use: through honest cloth, construction that can be repaired, and a repair service that never expires.
company.vision: A wardrobe where the oldest piece is also the favourite one.
values: Know the mill behind every metre
Price the true cost, not the trend
Make the inside as well as the outside

products.name: Halden Wool Overcoat
products.summary: A single-breasted overcoat in dense brushed wool, cut long and easy over knitwear.
products.description: Halden is the coat VAELO began with, recut every few years and never replaced. The cloth is a 680 g brushed wool that sheds rain and holds its shape; the canvas is half-floating so the chest moulds to you over a winter. Seams are taped and the lining is stitched in, not glued, so every part can be replaced when it wears.

features.title: Half-floating canvas
features.description: The chest canvas is stitched, not fused, so the coat softens to your shape instead of bubbling.

features.title: Built to be mended
features.description: Taped seams and a stitched-in lining mean cuffs, pockets and lining can all be replaced.

products.name: Sorrel Merino Crewneck
products.summary: A fine-gauge merino crewneck, fully fashioned so every seam sits flat.
products.description: Sorrel is knitted to shape on fully-fashioned machines, so the panels are linked rather than cut and overlocked. That keeps the seams flat and stops the hem and cuffs from twisting after washing. The yarn is a non-mulesed extra-fine merino, spun tight enough to resist pilling.

features.title: Fully fashioned
features.description: Panels are knitted to shape and linked stitch by stitch, with no cut edges.

features.title: Pilling-resistant spin
features.description: A tighter twist in the yarn keeps the surface clean for years, not weeks.

products.name: Ivory Cable Jumper
products.summary: A heavy cable-knit jumper in undyed wool, warm enough to wear as a jacket.
products.description: The cable panel runs from shoulder to hem without a break, which takes a slower knitting programme and twice the yarn of a plain jumper. The wool is left undyed, so the ivory is the colour of the fleece itself. It is the warmest thing we make that is not a coat.

features.title: Unbroken cables
features.description: The cable runs the full length of the body, knitted in one programme.

features.title: Undyed wool
features.description: No dye bath: the ivory is the natural colour of the fleece.

products.name: Tide Linen Shirt
products.summary: A garment-washed linen shirt with a soft collar, made for heat.
products.description: Tide is cut from a mid-weight European linen and washed after sewing, so it arrives soft and will not shrink again. The collar is unlined and hand-turned, the side seams are flat-felled, and the buttons are corozo nut. It looks better creased.

features.title: Washed after sewing
features.description: All the shrinkage happens before it reaches you, and the linen arrives soft.

features.title: Flat-felled seams
features.description: Every raw edge is folded inside, so the shirt is as neat inside as out.

products.name: Field Denim Jacket
products.summary: A chain-stitched denim jacket in 13 oz selvedge, rinsed once.
products.description: Field is sewn on restored chain-stitch machines, which roll the hem and side seams the way denim was made before overlockers. The 13 oz selvedge is rinsed once to remove starch and then left alone: it will fade to your wear, not to a factory pattern.

features.title: Chain-stitched
features.description: Seams roll and twist slightly over time, which is what gives old denim its character.

features.title: Rinsed once
features.description: No artificial fading: the colour changes only where you wear it.

products.name: Everyday Heavy Tee
products.summary: A 240 g cotton tee with a collar that keeps its shape after a hundred washes.
products.description: The jersey is knitted as a tube, so there are no side seams to twist. The collar is a 1×1 rib with a high Lycra-free cotton count, and the neck tape is sewn by hand at the back. We test every batch to 100 washes before we sell it.

features.title: Tubular knit
features.description: No side seams, so the body never twists around you.

features.title: Tested to 100 washes
features.description: Every batch is washed a hundred times in our studio before it goes on sale.

products.name: Straight Selvedge Jeans
products.summary: A straight-leg jean in 14 oz selvedge, with a hem we take up for free.
products.description: A mid-rise straight leg cut from 14 oz denim woven on narrow shuttle looms. The selvedge edge shows when you turn the cuff. We hem every pair to your length in the atelier, on a chain-stitch machine, at no charge.

features.title: Shuttle-loom denim

features.title: Free hemming
features.description: Tell us your inside leg and we chain-stitch the hem before it ships.

products.name: Loopback Hoodie
products.summary: A heavyweight loopback cotton hoodie with a double-layer hood.
products.description: Loopback cotton is knitted with loops left open on the inside, so it breathes better than brushed fleece and does not pill. The hood is double-layer so it holds its shape, and the rib cuffs are knitted with a thread of elastane to stop them from stretching out.

features.title: Loopback, not fleece

features.title: Double-layer hood

products.name: Studio Wool Blazer
products.summary: An unstructured blazer in tropical wool that packs flat and recovers overnight.
products.description: Studio has no shoulder pads and only a light canvas in the chest, so it moves like a cardigan and folds into a bag. Tropical wool is woven open, which makes it cool in summer and quick to recover from creasing. Also available made-to-measure from the same pattern.

features.title: Unstructured

features.title: Made-to-measure ready

products.name: Pleated Wool Trousers
products.summary: Single-pleat trousers with a high rise and a wide, straight leg.
products.description: A single forward pleat gives room through the hip; the leg falls straight from there. The waistband has side adjusters instead of belt loops, and there is 4 cm of extra cloth in the seat seam so they can be let out later.

features.title: Side adjusters

features.title: Room to let out

services.title: Made-to-measure
services.imageAlt: A tailor writing measurements on a clipboard in a sewing studio
services.summary: Any coat, blazer, trousers or shirt, cut from our patterns to your measurements.
services.description: Book a 45-minute fitting at the atelier. We take 22 measurements, choose cloth with you from our current bolts, and cut from the same pattern as the ready-to-wear piece, adjusted to you. A baste fitting follows two weeks later, and the finished garment four weeks after that.
benefits: 22 measurements, kept on file for next time
A baste fitting before the final sewing

services.title: Repairs for life
services.imageAlt: A black jacket lying on a sewing machine
services.summary: We repair anything VAELO has made, free, for as long as you own it.
services.description: Bring or post the piece to the atelier. We replace linings, re-knit elbows, reset buttons, re-hem jeans and patch with cloth from the original bolt when we still have it. The repair is free; you pay postage one way.
benefits: Free for every VAELO piece, forever
Original cloth used when we have it
Most repairs back within ten days

services.title: Wardrobe appointments
services.imageAlt: A clothing rail with neutral-coloured garments beside a cactus
services.summary: An hour with one of our makers to plan fewer, better pieces.
services.description: Bring photos of what you already wear. We help you find the gaps, try the pieces that fill them, and tell you honestly when the answer is a repair rather than something new.
benefits: One hour, one maker, no sales targets
Advice on what to keep and repair
Try any size or colour we make

services.title: Wholesale
services.imageAlt: Clothing racks with neutral-toned garments in a shop
services.summary: Small runs for independent shops that share how we work.
services.description: We supply a handful of independent shops each season, with minimums low enough for a small store. Stockists get the same repair promise for their customers and a line sheet six months before each season.

lookbooks.title: North Light
lookbooks.summary: Wool, cable and camel for short days and long walks.
lookbooks.story: North Light is about the hour after lunch in November, when the sun is already low. We built the season around the Halden coat and dressed it down with undyed knitwear, a soft blazer and boots that had already done a few winters.
lookbooks.credits: Photography: Unsplash contributors. Styling and casting: demo.
